maddeler.e:
استقذرن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْذَرْنَ (istaqḏarna) /is.taq.ðar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اُسْتُقْذِرْنَ (ustuqḏirna) /us.tuq.ðir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اِسْتَقْذِرْنَ (istaqḏirna) /is.taq.ðir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
